reviews.text: I’ve been taking my (now senior) dog here for years. Dr. Dayed and team have helped through numerous concerns. They are easy to work with, helping to talk through treatment options, never pressuring and always keeping the best interests of the animal in mind. Highly recommend this clinic

Most honest and kind vet I have ever sent my cats to. They actually care alot about not just the animals, but their customers. They are ready to ease any worries you have about your animal, and they run a calm environment for anxious animals. My cats left feeling much better every time. This is my go-to vet in Downtown Toronto!

It's a delight having Dr Dayed as our vet. He is the best vet in Toronto by no shadow of a doubt. He is also kind, talented and honest.

We have been lucky to have Dr Dayed as the vet for our cats for over 5 years and it's always a pleasure seeing him and working with him.

We also saw he had rescue cats and he works with the Humane Society to help fix rescues and do any surgeries they need for free!

We strongly recommend working with Dr Dayed and his wonderful team :)

Extremely reliable and always helpful vet and staff. I have a really nervous dog and they’re very good at handling and treating her. They do what’s best for my pup and are always able to fit her in in case of emergency, even if they’re busy.
I’ve been at this vet for many years. Dr Dayed is very good to my pet and his staff are friendly. No upselling and good recommendations to specialists.  Highly recommended this vet.
Always gives the best cat care
🙏🙏🙏Thank you🙏🙏🙏 …

I can never thank Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital enough for everything they have done for my family.

They were there for my beloved pug, Diesel, through some of the hardest moments of his life, always treating him with compassion, dignity, and genuine love. The care and support they provided during that time meant more to me than words can express.

Now, seeing the same level of kindness and dedication being given to my puppy, Enzo, reminds me why I trust them completely. Every member of the team is phenomenal, caring, knowledgeable, and always willing to go above and beyond for both pets and their people.

A special thank you to Dr. Dayed, who is absolutely amazing. His compassion, patience, and commitment to his patients are truly exceptional. I am so grateful to have a veterinarian I trust so completely with my dogs.

From Diesel to Enzo, Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital has been there every step of the way, and I will forever be grateful for the love and care they’ve shown my family.
Thank you 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 …

Truly an amazing veterinary practice I could not recommend it more. Dr. Dayed and all of the vet techs care about your pet and go above and beyond. Dr. Dayed creates an environment that I never feel pressured to do unnecessary procedures and I always trust his judgment. He is aware of how ridiculous vet costs can be and is 100% transparent in providing estimates. I truly trust him with my dog's health!
Thanks for your positive feedback 🙏🙏🙏🙏 …
Always caring solud advice, with no sales pressure.
Thank you for your support and positive feedback 🙏🙏🙏🙏 …

I can’t say enough good things about Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital. A huge thank you to Dr. Dayed for discovering that Pico had pancreatitis related to her diet after she turned two years old. We had previously gone to multiple vets, but Dr. Dayed was the one who was finally able to identify the root cause and help us resolve the issue.

Since then, Pico has been doing so much better, and we are incredibly grateful for the care, attention, and thoroughness of the team.

Because of the great experience we had, we now also bring my husband’s Boston Terrier, Crawford, here as well. It gives us such peace of mind knowing both of our dogs are in such capable and compassionate hands.

Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, caring, and trustworthy veterinary team. 🐾

Such a great vet clinic! The vet is very knowledgeable and patient, and the staff are incredibly kind and helpful. The onboarding process was quick and easy, and they were able to accommodate my appointment right away. Highly recommend for anyone looking for excellent care for their pets!
One of the worst places. Huge lack of communication. Not professional at all!

Dr Dayed and Team are excellent in every way. They care about their furry clients and go the extra mile to make
Sure the best care is being given. We are forever grateful for the team at Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital! Sparkles is very lucky to have Dr Dayed and Team

If you live around the area, definitely recommend this clinic! The staff here and Dr. Dayed have been really helpful with our cat who’s had surgery in the clinic recently. He was very helpful and shows genuine care, and knowledge for your pets. The pricing in the clinic is also a really good, fair and reasonable and can’t recommend it enough!

10/10 , Definitely Recommend this place ! they are very caring & Loving , Dr. B Dayed was very helpful with the situation happening with my cat he was very detailed in explaining everything step by step and answering all of my questions or concerns. This place is also very reasonable with Prices compared to others.

Dr Dayed is a wonderful person who cares your fur baby. I have been working with him to solve my foster cats digestion problems. He really goes above and beyond to help!

Update: I still stand by my rating after 6 years. The team have been the best I could ask for.
My kitties love Dr.Dayed

Dr Bikram Dayed is a wonderful vet, he takes great care in his patients, both human and furry, patiently answering any questions you have regarding your pet.  I highly recommend the Dundas Dovercourt animal hospital.

Dr. Dayed and the entire staff at Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital were absolutely incredible! My dog was in severe pain, and while other hospitals couldn’t help, Dr. Dayed provided the care and relief my pet desperately needed. The compassion, knowledge, and professionalism here truly set them apart. I would recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring place for their pets. You can be confident they’ll be in excellent hands!

The team here is fantastic! Very caring and skilled with dogs. They take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure your pet feels comfortable. Prices are fair compared to other clinics, and you can tell they genuinely prioritize the animals’ well-being. Definitely a place you can trust with your pets.

We walked in with our dog after an altercation, not sure if we would be seen or relayed to an emergency vet - Dr. Dayed and his team took us in right away, assessed the situation with care, cleaned the wound and got us situated with the right meds. We didn't have a vet in Toronto yet, but we're grateful to have found Dundas Dovercourt!
Thank you so much for your support and positive feedback 🙏🙏🙏 …

We had an urgent situation with our dog Maya on a Saturday. I called our vet that morning, and although his schedule was already full for the day, he took the time to listen and once he understood the seriousness, he kindly made space to see her the same day (almost immediately)

What truly stood out was the level of care we received. He didn’t just rush through or offer a quick fix. Instead, he thoroughly assessed Maya’s condition, did blood work, administered injections, prescribed medications, and explained everything clearly. It was, without a doubt, the best care Maya has received so far.

This isn’t the first veterinary clinic we’ve been to but it’s rare to find a vet who is not only skilled, but genuinely passionate, compassionate, and attentive. I’m so grateful, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this clinic to anyone looking for high-quality, heartfelt care for their pets.

Dr Dayed and his team are great! They are able to handle my very feisty cat and don't use sedation unless absolutely necessary, which I really appreciate. Their pricing is very reasonable, especially compared to other vets in the area. And you can tell that they care about the animal's wellbeing above all.

I can't suggest this vet enough, he gives excellent care, is attentive and thoughtful answering questions and concerns and offering his number for after hour questions should something happen, he is very fair with his prices and services and I count myself lucky to have been referred him by a friend, definitely visit if youre looking for a vet that cares about animals more than profit
Dr Dayed is very caring, knowledgeable and transparent.

Easily the best bet in the city! We came here over a recommendation of a friend after months of frustrating experience with our original vet regarding my pup’s allergy issues. What our vet couldn’t figure out for months, Dr. Bayed got it solved within the first week. Definitely changed our primary vet care to him!

I’ve been recommended and visited several animal hospitals, but I haven’t found one as kind and sincere as this vet. My small and elderly dog had been gradually losing her vision for the past few months. I went to multiple clinics trying to find the cause, but no one could identify the issue, and some even pushed unnecessary tests that ended up being pointless.
But this place was different. The vet here kindly referred us to a specialized veterinary eye clinic and truly did his best to help us. I’m really grateful. If anyone is looking for a trustworthy, kind, and non-pushy vet clinic where you can feel at ease leaving your pets, I 100% recommend this place.

Dr Dayed has been the vet for my two cats for several years. He is calm, patient and very well informed and doesn't pressure you into making decisions. Also he communicates via email too which is handy.

The prices here are very reasonable for Toronto Vet services and the receptionists pick up the phone promptly and you can usually get an appointment within a few days.

Dr Dayed is so beyond kind and caring. Our cats have both been sick at different times and he’s called to check in with us after hours, gone above and beyond to make sure they had the best care possible. I cannot recommend him enough. The people who work with him are also really lovely! Chantal in particular is always very sweet to our cat. We’re so lucky we happened to move really close by and went here.
Good prices and great doctor! We were travelling overseas and had complicated case. But we were able to do everything thanks to this doctor.

I have been coming here for over 10 years. I was so lucky to find an amazing vet so close to home for my first time as a pet owner.
I moved out of the neighbourhood but still bring my cat here!
Dr. Dayed is always so kind, helpful and reliable in so many ways. All the staff are so friendly.
Everyone is so caring and gentle with your pets !!!!

I cannot say enough good things about this place!! After being gouged my every veterinarian I have ever used, this is the first hospital that really seems to care and the value of their service is immeasurable. I’m so grateful for the staff at Dundas Dovercourt Animal Hospital for their help with my cat. Take your pet here!!

My best little friend Jazz was diagnosed  with diabetes last week  I didn't know how Jazz and I were going to get through it but Dr Dayed and staff are amazing and I walked out of the clinic with a renewed confidence  and the tools to start Jazz on his way back  to good health . Thank You
Sincerely Ross @ Jazz

We are very grateful to Doctor Dayed, as last November we had a very bad experience at another clinic with our dog, which unfortunately ended in terminal cancer. However, Dr. Dayed was very empathetic and sensitive. He referred us to a clinic for further tests and to see an oncologist. He was always attentive to us, even after we stopped coming in for consultations. He is a doctor with true vocation, and we are thankful that he gave us what no one else did: hope. Our dog was able to stay with us for almost four more months. We will always be grateful to him and will always recommend him. Thank you, Dr. Dayed.

Dr. Dayed did an amazing job with my cat. She needed quite a bit of dental extractions and he was kind, gentle, professional, transparent with pricing, and overall made me feel very comfortable leaving my cat in his care for this procedure.

My cat made such a smooth, quick recovery thanks to the team here. Everybody who works here is so welcoming, you can tell they truly care about what they do, and do it very well.

I will definitely be a returning client. Thank you guys again❤️

I took my 2 cats to get them spayed and they treated them very well, very good service and the doctor was very kind ❤️
I always recommend them.
🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏Thank you …

Excellent treatment and understanding of our highly sensitive dog. Top tier care & customer service. Dr. D, called several times to check up on our pet and makes himself available to take our calls when we have questions. Very fair pricing compared to most other clinics. Highly recommend.

Dr. Dayed is such a golden human being. Kind, thoughtful, knowledgeable, and incredibly caring about every pet he sees. Such amazing and patient staff, full of love and compassion. You get all this with the most reasonable prices you'll find in Toronto as well (I know because I called like 40 of them!). Do your pet (and wallet) a favour and register them here!

In my opinion, Dr. Dayed is the best vet in the city! He truly loves animals, and I know he works to help stray cats. He charges reasonable prices and is very polite and kind. I trust my animals with him entirely. Do not hesitate to take your fur baby to this clinic; he will care for you and your pets!
Dr. Dayed is the best vet in the city, he has cared for two generations of cats for me and they have all been in good hands. Reasonable prices and a fantastic human. Thanks for the years of service.
Thank you so much 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 …
